hero.title: Made for the thrill of the next swing
hero.subtitle: Mad Miners is an independent game from Nepal about racing friends to a treasure, deep underground, where anything can be behind the next rock.

story.title: The story
paragraphs: Mad Miners started with a simple idea: put a dozen miners in the same mine, hide a treasure at the bottom, and see who gets there first.

Then the mine fought back. Lava that hides behind the rock, TNT that counts down from three, launcher pads that throw you across a cave, monsters in the dark and Mystery Bombs that might hold a jackpot or a spider.
Every match is a brand new mine, so no two digs are ever the same.

items.title: Fair play
items.text: No pay-to-win. Everything you can buy only changes how your miner looks.

items.title: Honesty
items.text: Bots are always labelled. Rewards are decided by the server, never faked.

items.title: Privacy
items.text: No ads, no tracking, no selling data. We only keep what the game needs to work.

items.title: Smooth on any phone
items.text: Built to run well on mid-range Android phones, with a graphics setting for older devices.
